goal: Make worldgen look like a cozy farm/tavern world without abandoning tile precision.
validation_rules: Every exterior scene has at least one valid transition path.
Natural water tiles must mark fishable=true unless explicitly unsafe.
Build mode forbids placement on deep water, cliff, wall, cave wall, and active construction hazard tiles.
Farm actions use soil_state overlay, not separate terrain replacement for every crop condition.
A 96x64 SceneMap is the expanded standard playable scene; 144x96 is reserved for future large scenes.
Tavern, farm, cave, and road features must stay at local tile scale inside a scene.
Island-scale previews must use a region/world graph, not a single Farmstead SceneMap.

scale_contract.region_map_role: abstract island/region composition across multiple scenes
invalid_preview_signals: tavern footprint appears close to island footprint
farm field covers most of the island
road appears as a full-map band unless scene_kind is road_connector
island silhouette and local structure footprints are drawn at the same scale

starter_scene_targets.farmstead: tavern + farm grid + mountain/cave + river + road
starter_scene_targets.south_field: larger farming grid and soil quality bands
starter_scene_targets.cave_mouth: non-grid-looking cave within tile collision grid
